title: Tax engine migration flag in a payroll run
name: Payroll run executor

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this payroll run uses the tax_engine_v2 flag? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The flag store is unreachable and getBoolean falls back to its fallback argument. Which engine do payslips use?
choices: v2, because it is the newer engine
The run fails because the flag could not be read
Whichever engine the previous run used
v1, because the fallback passed is false

questions.prompt: savePayslips throws after all slips are computed. What is the final state?
choices: The run is marked failed and the error is rethrown with the run ID in the message
The run is marked done because all slips were computed
The run stays in processing and the error is swallowed
Half the payslips are saved and the run is marked done

questions.prompt: An employee earns 52,000 a year, has 2,500 of pretax deductions per period, and lives in CA. With v2 enabled, what is their taxable income for the period?
